items.title: Bhayshul Tuten: Cleared for Sunday
items.text:
Tuten (ankle/foot) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's matchup with Tennessee, ESPN's Michael DiRocco reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Drew Lock: Cleared to start Sunday
items.text:
Lock (right elbow/oblique) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game at Las Vegas, Brady Henderson on ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Harold Fannin: Ready to play Sunday
items.text:
Fannin (groin) was a full participant in Friday's practice and doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Texans, Chris Easterling of the Akron Beacon Journal reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kirk Cousins: Starting in Week 10
items.text:
Head coach Kevin O'Connell announced Friday that Cousins will start Sunday's contest at Green Bay.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Adonai Mitchell: Listed as questionable after FP
items.text:
Mitchell (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bills after he was a full participant in Friday's practice.
